name: last-updated
title: Last updated
description: An Updated 3 min ago label with a refresh button that keeps itself current, and says in words and weight when the data has gone stale.
docs: updatedAt takes a Date, a timestamp or an ISO string. The text counts minutes, then gives a clock time after an hour (with the date once it is not today), written in locale and timeZone so the server and the browser agree; before the page is live it shows the date and time instead of an age. Past staleAfterMs (15 minutes) it adds a warning mark and 'may be out of date'. onRefresh shows the button: return a promise and the arrow turns until it settles (a rejection stops it without saying Data refreshed), or drive refreshing yourself. labels takes your own words as templates with {n}, {time}, {date} and {text}.
